defects.problem: Calling C♯ minor 'closely related' to D♭ major risks the technical meaning of closely related keys. This is an enharmonically respelled parallel-minor relationship, not the usual relative/dominant neighbouring-key relationship.
defects.evidence: Opened https://chopin.nifc.pl/en/chopin/kompozycja/208 and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prelude,_Op._28,_No._15_(Chopin) : outer D♭ major and middle C♯ minor, with A♭ respelled G♯.
defects.fix: Replace 'differently spelled but closely related world of C♯ minor' with a plain accurate phrase such as 'a darker minor-key setting written C♯ minor' or 'the enharmonically respelled parallel minor, C♯ minor'.

defects.problem: The definite range 1836–39 is narrower than the cited primary work record supports.
defects.evidence: Opened https://chopin.nifc.pl/en/chopin/kompozycja/208 : creation date 1831(?)–1839; the Institute's prelude overview describes completion in 1839.
